text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, what do you think? Aren't you 
starting to get interested in Umadol 
activities by now?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's make sure everyone learns even more 
about Espo-san's charm!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way! Like I'd ever suck up to 
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh~! But, but I feel like it's such a 
waste. Because—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. What did I just ask you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hey, stop it! Say something! Hey!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Look at that~~! Your expressions change so 
quickly! I can't take my eyes off you for 
even a second!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Making people feel like "I want to keep 
watching you forever..." That has to be a 
natural gift for being an Umadol~~!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
SHUT UPPP!! When I say I ain't doing it, I 
AIN'T DOING IT!!!!
